description: Dataset of Urban Transport Infrastructure Finance in the Global South, 1967-2025 is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Leah Lazer (University of Basel). This dataset compiles urban transport infrastructure projects across over 130 countries in the Global South, spanning 1967–2025. It was constructed by harmonizing, deduplicating, and enriching four international development finance databases: the IATI Datastore, the World Bank Private Participation in Infrastructure (PPI) database, the OECD Mobilisation of Private Finance for Development survey, and the AidData Global ... Coverage: global; the metadata date the deposit to 2027. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
